description: This file defines the internal class OutsideRuntimeClient, which implements IRuntimeClient, IDisposable, and IClusterConnectionStatusListener. It manages client-side runtime operations for Orleans, including message sending and receiving, managing object references, handling cluster connection notifications, and coordinating client startup and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: OutsideRuntimeClient
classes.description: A partial internal class implementing Orleans client runtime, managing message exchanges, object references, connection status, and lifecycle.

methods.name: ConsumeServices
methods.description: Initializes internal services and components needed for the runtime client operation.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the runtime client, including establishing connections and initializing message center.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the runtime client, disposing resources and terminating ongoing operations.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message back to a requester based on a received request.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message to a target grain, with callback handling for responses.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Processes an incoming response message, matching callbacks or updating status.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference object for a given IAddressable object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Removes a grain reference object from internal management.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current response timeout setting.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers that the cluster connection was lost.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers about changes in the number of gateways.

methods.name: MonitorCallbackExpiry
methods.description: Periodically checks for callbacks that have expired and triggers timeout handling.

methods.name: ThrowIfDisposed
methods.description: Throws an ObjectDisposedException if the object has already been disposed.
